**[P2] Clean up the entry-point factory that fails validation**

An entry point can resolve to an opted-in factory that owns constructor resources but has an invalid `create_plugin` signature or a raising descriptor. Validation then fails before `_resolve_configured_factories()` appends that factory to `resolved_factories`, so the outer rejection handler never calls its `on_registration_result(False)`. An imported singleton can retain its worker or open resources after handler initialization fails. Include the loaded candidate in rejection cleanup before validating it, and add an entry-point regression that checks the failing factory's own resources.
